meta.title: When the current owner is deactivated, ownership can go to any active user anywhere
gaps: The setup requires an event whose owner's UserCompanyMapping is inactive, a super-admin caller, and an active user from another company; no setup recipe creates this state.
The required target user token {{userUuid}} is not available in the TOKENS list.
No operation or library case expresses POST /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}/change_ownership with an active foreign user's UUID.
